intro
Nyambika Vision two. An AI native redesign. No lists, no search boxes, no forms. Just you, your intent, and Rwandan makers.
analysis

Version one followed a traditional pattern: browse, search, filter, open, tap, and fill forms. The redesign replaces it with six principles: intent over search, you first, gestures over buttons, conversation, spatial views, and makers at the centre.
mirror
It starts with a five second mirror moment. Aline turns once in front of the camera and creates a private digital twin. It is encrypted, and she can delete it any time.
muse

There is no feed to scroll. The Muse listens. Aline says, in Kinyarwanda, that she needs a wedding outfit for Saturday, under fifty thousand francs. The Muse understands the occasion, budget and style.
snap
Or she simply points her camera at a fabric she loves. The Muse recognises the kitenge print, and finds the makers who work with it.
looks
Instantly, looks appear already on her twin, from real member makers. She swipes up for the next look, and double taps to save.
morph
Dragging the colour ring recolours the dress live. Because Uwase is a tailor, Aline can adjust the length and sleeves, and Uwase sews it to her measurements.
spin
A pinch spins her twin in three D, or she flips to the live A R mirror, to see the look on herself in real time.
circle
She asks her circle. Friends vote on the looks in real time, right inside the experience.
maker
Swiping left on the maker opens Uwase Couture's Maker Space, her own immersive page, with her story, collections and reviews. The member keeps her page and her customers.
hold
To buy, Aline simply holds. Size comes from her twin, delivery is suggested, and Mobile Money is approved with her fingerprint. Payment goes directly to the maker.
ambient
After purchase, everything is ambient. A live activity tracks the order, the maker sends updates, and the dress joins her digital wardrobe for future styling.
compare
The result: from eleven steps to four moments. From over twenty taps to about six gestures. And from minutes of searching, to under a minute.
outro
Nyambika Vision two. Ask. See it on you. Hold to buy. Designed for twenty twenty six and beyond, around Rwandan makers.
